source: INTEGRATION.md (edge alarm contract) and cloud/README.md (server-side scope)
principles: Deadband samples hold the current alarm state and do not advance clear progress.
Debounce counts consecutive qualifying samples, not accumulated ones.
The edge publishes severity and active_alarms; dashboard status uses those values.
Server-side copies use identical thresholds and exist as rubric evidence only.

rules.name: Supply Interruption
rules.raise: flow_lpm == 0 sustained for EDGE_FLOW_ZERO_SUSTAINED_S (30 s demo, 1800 s production)
rules.implementation: edge alarm; server rule uses device inactivity/time window

rules.name: Node Inactive
rules.raise: no generated reading for EDGE_NODE_INACTIVE_S (90 s demo)
rules.implementation: edge alarm; server import file mirrors the published node_inactive boolean; separate device-profile inactivity timeout is 180 min normal / 45 min burst (work division)
rules.note: These two inactivity mechanisms are distinct and must both be documented.

rules.name: Rapid Turbidity Rise
rules.raise: Hampel-cleaned turbidity rise > 30 NTU within EDGE_DERIVATIVE_WINDOW_S (50 s demo)
rules.implementation: device profile alarm rule (native Alarm Rules tab) mirroring the edge-derived alarm via active_alarms CONTAINS; dashboard uses edge-published severity

rules.name: Severe pH Persistence
rules.implementation: device profile alarm rule (native Alarm Rules tab) mirroring the edge-derived alarm via active_alarms CONTAINS

rules.name: Sensor Fault
rules.raise: 3 consecutive validity-gate failures (SATURATION, OPEN_SHORT, STUCK or SANITY)
rules.implementation: device profile alarm rule (native Alarm Rules tab) mirroring active_alarms CONTAINS 'Sensor Fault'; edge severity is Fault, server severity CRITICAL
